title: Verwijzing naar de data van: Frame of reference and sentencing
descriptions: This study looks at the effects of a frame of reference, in which the case in hand is compared with other, more or less severe crimes, on sentencing.
Data available in consultation with NSCR. Please contact the datamanager [datamanagement@nscr.nl]
description: This study looks at the effects of a frame of reference, in which the case in hand is compared with other, more or less severe crimes, on sentencing.
data_sources: Students of Leiden University and University of Amsterdam (N = 290 experiment 1, 143 experiment 2). In two similar experiments, participants were given a fictious case file regarding an assualt with varying levels of severity. After reading the case file, participants were asked to decide on an appropriate punishment. The research conditions differed in the degree to which participants could form a frame of reference (other case files).
